description: This file defines the FaqSubController class within the Goteo content management system, specifically managing FAQ (Frequently Asked Questions) within the admin section. It includes methods for CRUD operations, ordering, translation, and permission checks for FAQ entries.

classes.name: FaqSubController
classes.description: Controller class for managing FAQ sub-entries in the admin panel, with methods for translating, editing, adding, ordering, removing, and listing FAQ items, along with permission handling.

methods.name: isAllowed
methods.description: Checks if a user has permission to manage FAQs for a specific node, allowing only master nodes.

methods.name: translateAction
methods.description: Handles translation requests for a FAQ entry.

methods.name: editAction
methods.description: Handles editing of a FAQ entry.

methods.name: addAction
methods.description: Handles adding a new FAQ entry.

methods.name: upAction
methods.description: Moves a FAQ entry up in order.

methods.name: downAction
methods.description: Moves a FAQ entry down in order.

methods.name: listAction
methods.description: Lists all FAQ entries for a specific section.

methods.name: process
methods.description: Main method to process actions like add, edit, remove, order, and list FAQ items, including handling form submissions and data validation.
